title: Lexicon Pharmaceuticals, Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-30
summary: Lexicon Pharmaceuticals filed an 8-K on April 30, 2026, reporting the automatic conversion of 408,434.7 shares of Series B Convertible Preferred Stock into 20,421,735 shares of common stock, stockholder approval of expanded equity incentive plans, and an amendment increasing authorized common stock from 450 million to 900 million shares.
key_points: Series B Convertible Preferred Stock (408,434.7 shares) automatically converted into 20,421,735 common shares at a 50:1 ratio on April 30, 2026
2026 Equity Incentive Plan approved, increasing share pool from 75 million to 90 million shares
2026 Non-Employee Directors' Equity Incentive Plan approved, increasing share pool from 4 million to 6 million shares
Authorized common stock increased from 450,000,000 to 900,000,000 shares via Seventh Amended and Restated Certificate of Incorporation
Class II directors (Barker, Sobecki, Swain) re-elected with approximately 297-298 million votes for each
Ernst & Young LLP ratified as independent auditors for fiscal year 2026
